listSources: Exophase and PSNProfiles trophy lists (names, descriptions and grades agree); methods researched from PowerPyx's GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap and the guides named in each trophy's sources. All guides below are written in our own words for this entry — sources are cited, never copied.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops. There are no online or DLC trophies, so this is a pure single-player set. Budget around 200 hours — the long pole is A Long Road (100% completion), not the story. No difficulty setting exists, so nothing here asks for a harder mode.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops after the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Just play the story — no preparation needed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 1 ends, as the game moves into Chapter 2 with the mission 'What's in the Bag?'. Finish the chapter's missions and it unlocks on its own.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, as Chapter 3 opens with 'Welcome to Vice City'. Keep playing the main missions and it unlocks by itself.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 3 ends, after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 ('Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'). No side content is required for it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 4 ends, after its final main mission 'Starting From Zero'. Just finish the chapter.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops after the final mission of the game in Chapter 5. Keep a manual save before the finale if you want to revisit anything afterwards — there is no mission replay, though free-roam stays open after the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 2 main mission 'Breakfast Run'. Play the mission and it unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 3 main mission 'The Cartel Heist'. It is part of the story, so no extra step is needed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission 'Child's Play'. Play the mission and it unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission 'Headliners'. It is part of the story, so no extra step is needed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission 'VCIA Takedown'. Play the mission and it unlocks as part of the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 5 main mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. It is part of the story, so no extra step is needed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy. Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story (progress made during the story already counts). The bar is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion: 100 optional missions, scan 200 of 277 base vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and everything stays doable in free-roam after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the categories however you like — flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. The story introduces most of them; the rest appear as blue dumbbell icons on the map. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done. You will tick most of these off naturally while working on other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Gold is the top medal tier — learn each range's timing and use its own weapons. The ranges also level up your Focus, which helps Gunslinger. There is a dedicated locations guide for all 12 ranges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). You only need one win per location, not every race. The drone races are marked on the map once you find them.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — car races, race challenges or Top Fun drone races each count once per unique location. There are 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many as you need; pick the ones you enjoy and skip the rest.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission 'Feng Shui' (meeting Cal), Cal texts you a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. The questline opens early, so do it when it appears.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game (called 'Video Games' in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind at the TV at home (playable from Chapter 1), or Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines around the world. Finish all of a game's levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia-only questline. In Chapter 3 Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville, marking the questline on the map. Complete her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline, marked automatically in Chapter 1 (green 'KR' icon in Key Lento, after the 'Island Dreams' mission). Clear 7 shipwrecks: he marks purple treasure chests on the map, dive down and use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, then bring it back to him. Kenton goes quiet late in Chapter 1 but returns in Chapter 2-3 — call Brian as Jason to speed it up. Track under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline, marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain strangers count: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), plus more the community is still confirming. Note that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Track your count in the trophy list. All strands stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline 'Randy's Wish List', marked after the Chapter 3 mission 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS' (stealing the Zorrusso). He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green 'RK' icon). Scan cars with the Waink app to check the wishlist, then drive them back — in good condition for more pay. The Zorrusso itself is delivered during the mission. Still doable after the story; track under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 3 mission 'Here, Kitty Kitty', purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs in 'Take Out Kitty Litter', then Tyrone gives you 'Spin On This' (shut down the labs). All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE potentially missable trophy — do the Chapter 1 meditation first. There are 18 spots across 10 locations (Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations); meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts +2. The missable one: after the Chapter 1 mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she will meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose 'Accept'. That balcony meditation is gone forever after Chapter 1. Whether it counts toward the trophy is still unconfirmed, but the guide author did it and earned the trophy — do it to be safe. The last spot needs both characters playable (after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break'). Note: 100% completion only needs 15 of 18 spots, so the missable one cannot block A Long Road.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason-only questline. After the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break', Bret Vogel texts Jason and marks 'Veteran Hunted' in Lummox County. Do his first quest; he then marks hunting spots (purple icons) and gives you the 'Killtelligence SM-69' rifle — one clean shot leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. Track under Map > Activities > Target Deck; all 15 decks are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card-set locations across Leonida — find the cards and finish three full sets. A dedicated locations guide lists all 18 sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan 100 locations: hold Up + R1 to scan landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23). More than 100 exist, so any 100 count — scan whatever you pass. The same scans feed the vehicle and animal counts for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so this pops naturally on the way — there are 10 more challenges than you need for any trophy, so skip the hardest ones. Track under Progress > Challenges. Leave this for late in your run and most of it will already be done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Needs both characters (after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break'). Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone — the trophy pops once you drive out of it, not just out of the flashing search area. Easiest escape: a fast sports bike through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County), where cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally in the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' and during bank vault robberies.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Needs both characters (after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break'). With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping a wanted level (the red/blue flashing level, not the red heat level). Wear a vest and carry sticky bombs plus Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs') — loot a few items in each, and break the safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop; if it does not pop, hit a 4th shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan passing vehicles (hold R1) — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. 557 vehicles exist at launch; stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning past 100. Track under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming). It slows time and highlights weak spots, but only lasts a few seconds. Buff focus first (food, drinks, washing up at home, Adrenaline to extend it), then line up 5 enemies — gang operations are a good spot — and do not miss. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); it rises from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — not the planes parked on the airfield. Easiest is terminal E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away and it pops (slightly delayed). You can also walk in through the terminal.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance. Get in a Rhino and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3 'Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs' — it unlocks the Snap Gun (silent lockpick) and jewelry store robberies (green icons on the map). Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm. Find the safe code note in the back room and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (wait at the cafe) — it teaches vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (purple icons on the map). Each robbery gives an instant 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles to shake the heat. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so this pops on the way. Up to $205,000 per bank.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — robbing a bank vault there counts and the trophy pops. Earlier option: block an armored truck near a bank (keep it where you want it), sticky-bomb its back door (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests), then escape the red heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida and fully unfog the map. Fastest by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is clear. A dedicated guide lists the 52 areas if you want to check which ones are left.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked by yellow icons when you are near them; there are 39 in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way. Track per gang under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no confirmed method yet. PowerPyx lists this as not yet known; the leading guess is a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach (the description's wording). Do not trust any video or post claiming a sure method until the trophy lists and guide sites agree — this guide will be updated when the community confirms it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no confirmed method yet. PowerPyx lists this as not yet known. The description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, but no reliable step-by-step exists yet. This guide will be updated when the community confirms one — do not trust unverified claims.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling (a gang operation in Port Gellhorn): the luxury watch (south-east office), the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' (north-east table), and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation). It unlocks during the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling'. The trophy pops after you escape the police — and you do not need all 3 in one visit: the robbery icon respawns, so come back for anything left.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength, the heart icon). Needs both characters (after Chapter 2 'Coffee Break'). Buy a fitness club membership and always train together — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. While one trains, the other completes theirs too, so training together doubles progress. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile (click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count). Turn on notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a demon face appears when an action counts. Stealthy objectives and clean escapes push 'Professional'; incapacitating (not killing) pushes 'Hardened'; killing pushes 'Violent'; mass cop/civilian kills push 'Psycho'; excessive violence can lock 'Irredeemable', which is PERMANENT and makes cops shoot on sight — avoid it. It accumulates passively from robberies and fights; farm it last by running over civilians/cops if needed.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no confirmed method yet. PowerPyx lists this as not yet known; it is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue ('second time's the charm'). No reliable step-by-step exists yet — this guide will be updated when the community confirms one.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no confirmed method yet. PowerPyx lists this as not yet known; it is believed to be from a UFO questline. No reliable step-by-step exists yet — this guide will be updated when the community confirms one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED at launch — no confirmed method yet. PowerPyx lists this as not yet known; it is believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle ('bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by'). No reliable step-by-step exists yet — this guide will be updated when the community confirms one.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts (cumulative, not at once). First finish Chapter 3 'Credit Check' (meeting Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery (unlocked after Chapter 4 'That's Where The Money Is…').
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (cumulative). Fastest on the most expensive things: guns, car mods and tattoos. Shops: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total). They unlock after the Chapter 2 mission 'Daily Driver' (stealing the Crawler for Moses) — a 'Vice City Real Estate' app appears on your phone; buy through it. Four more garages come from the story and do not count. Robberies in Chapters 3-4 fund this.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission 'Moses' (taking a vehicle to Moses). Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, click 'Respray' then 'Register'. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money — use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
